name: fix-intellij-inspections
description: Fix accepted IntelliJ inspection findings in file groups, independently review them, then verify centrally.

step.prompt: Establish one fresh accepted IntelliJ inspection baseline for this TokTrak working tree. Run `node .claude/skills/toktrak-intellij-inspection/scripts/run.mjs` exactly once. Do not run test, verify, ci, coverage, pit, or another inspection run. Capture the report path printed by the runner, then read that report and its sibling `findings.tsv`. Include every finding without omission, but keep the structured result compact: group by complete files, combine small neighboring files from one package or tool scope, and isolate large or high-coupling files. Each group must carry the fresh report path, all files, distinct inspection IDs, and the exact total finding count. Use a stable concise groupId derived from scope and files. Do not modify source, test, tool, inspection-profile, or reference files. The runner may generate its normal output artifacts.

Act as the planner for this complete IntelliJ inspection file group: {item}. Read the group's fresh `findings.tsv`, filter it to every listed file, and read enough nearby source and tests to understand behavior. Assess each finding individually. Design the smallest behavior-preserving edits for actionable findings. Retain a finding only when the inspected code proves it intentional or the proposed change would reduce clarity or safety; group retained line numbers only when they share one exact rationale. Echo groupId, scope, and files exactly. Do not mutate anything. Do not change inspection profiles, accepted or wontfix ID lists, or add suppressions. Do not run the inspection runner, mise, Java, builds, formatters, linters, or tests. You may use only quick read-only inspection commands.

Implement the actionable IntelliJ inspection fixes from the inventory and fixer plans. Inventory: {inventory.results}. Successful plans: {fixers.results}. Failed fixer agents: {fixers.failures}. For every failed or incomplete plan, read that group's files and fresh baseline and design the missing decision yourself. Preserve unrelated working-tree changes and existing behavior; make only the smallest edits needed. Do not change inspection profiles, accepted or wontfix ID lists, add suppressions, or edit generated inspection output. Do not run the inspection runner, mise, Java, builds, formatters, linters, or tests; validation belongs to the final phase. Return every changed file, applied group, unresolved group, and material note.

Independently review the implemented IntelliJ inspection work for this complete file group: {item}. Fix plans: {fixers.results}. Application summary: {apply.results}. Read the fresh baseline, current files, relevant tests, and scoped git diff. Check each baseline finding individually: every actionable finding must be resolved, every retained finding must have a code-specific defensible rationale, semantics and exception, resource, numeric, and concurrency behavior must remain correct, and no unrelated churn may appear. Echo groupId exactly. Return clean=true only if no correction is needed. Do not mutate anything. Do not change inspection configuration or run the inspection runner, mise, Java, builds, formatters, linters, or tests. You may use only quick read-only inspection commands.

Finish the accepted IntelliJ inspection cleanup. Inventory: {inventory.results}. Fixer plans: {fixers.results}. Application: {apply.results}. Independent reviews: {reviewers.results}. Reviewer failures: {reviewers.failures}. Inspect and correct every real review issue, unresolved group, and group whose reviewer failed. Preserve unrelated working-tree changes. Never change inspection profiles, accepted or wontfix ID lists, add suppressions, or edit generated inspection reports to hide findings. After all source edits are complete, format only changed Java paths, run `mise run verify` once, then run `node .claude/skills/toktrak-intellij-inspection/scripts/run.mjs` once and read the newly printed report and sibling `findings.tsv`. Compare every remaining finding against current code and the reviewed retained rationales. If validation exposes a real issue, fix it and rerun only the necessary formatting, `mise run verify`, and inspection runner; never rerun a blocking command without an intervening relevant edit. Do not run ci, coverage, or pit. Return success=true only when formatting, compilation, configured checks, and the full tests pass, no actionable accepted finding remains, and every reported remaining finding has a concrete reviewed rationale. List exact commands, all changed files, the final report path, compact remaining finding groups, and any blocker.
